herb-lavender.bestTime: Midsummer — harvest flower spikes just as buds open (June–July), strongest around Litha

herb-rosemary.bestTime: Spring to early summer, harvest before flowering (Apr–June); evergreen, so usable year-round, potent at Yule

herb-common-sage.bestTime: Early summer before flowering (May–June), dried by Lammas for winter workings

herb-white-sage.bestTime: Late spring to summer (May–Aug); burn at any sabbat for consecration, especially Samhain cleansing

herb-mugwort.bestTime: Midsummer — gather on St. John's Eve (late June) through Lammas, traditionally at dusk

herb-yarrow.bestTime: Midsummer — harvest in full flower on St. John's Eve (June–Aug)

herb-chamomile.bestTime: Summer, pick flower heads at full bloom on sunny mornings (June–Aug), strong at Litha

herb-peppermint.bestTime: High summer just before flowering (July–Aug); fresh energy around Beltane

herb-basil.bestTime: High summer, pinch tops before flowering (July–Aug), strongest at Lammas

herb-thyme.bestTime: Late spring to midsummer at flowering (May–July), favoured at Beltane and Litha for faery work

herb-bay-laurel.bestTime: Evergreen; harvest leaves late summer (Aug–Sept); strongest at Midsummer and Yule (solar)

herb-cinnamon.bestTime: Imported bark, worked year-round; strongest at Yule and Litha (solar fire)

herb-clove.bestTime: Imported bud, year-round; strongest in winter, Yule to Imbolc

herb-nutmeg.bestTime: Imported seed, year-round; prosperity work at Lammas and Mabon

herb-star-anise.bestTime: Imported, year-round; strongest at Samhain and Yule for divination

herb-ginger.bestTime: Dig rhizomes in autumn (Sept–Nov); strongest Yule to Imbolc for fire and energy

herb-garlic.bestTime: Harvest bulbs midsummer (July) as leaves yellow; plant at Samhain; strongest late autumn

herb-rose.bestTime: Early summer in full bloom (June), Beltane to Litha; hips at Samhain

herb-jasmine.bestTime: Summer nights at full bloom (June–Sept), gather after dusk

herb-calendula.bestTime: Summer to first frost, pick at noon in full sun (June–Oct), strongest at Litha

herb-st-johns-wort.bestTime: Midsummer — harvest on St. John's Eve / Day (June 23–24), at noon

herb-vervain.bestTime: Midsummer at flowering, gathered at dawn or when Sirius rises (late June–July)

herb-wormwood.bestTime: Late summer in flower (Aug); strongest at Samhain

herb-rue.bestTime: Summer before flowering (June–July); strongest at Samhain for hex breaking

herb-valerian.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn of 2nd year (Sept–Oct); strongest at Mabon

herb-lemon-balm.bestTime: Early summer before flowering (June–July), strongest at Litha

herb-hyssop.bestTime: Midsummer in flower (July–Aug); used for cleansing at Imbolc and before any rite

herb-patchouli.bestTime: Year-round dried leaf; strongest at Lammas and Mabon (harvest abundance)

herb-sandalwood.bestTime: Year-round resinous wood; strongest at full moons and Samhain

herb-frankincense.bestTime: Resin collected in dry season (spring–autumn); strongest at Yule and Litha

herb-myrrh.bestTime: Resin, year-round; strongest at Samhain and Yule (ancestor and consecration work)

herb-dragons-blood.bestTime: Resin, year-round; strongest at Beltane and Litha (fire and power)

herb-copal.bestTime: Resin, year-round; strongest at Samhain / Día de Muertos (Oct 31–Nov 2)

herb-benzoin.bestTime: Resin, year-round; strongest at Imbolc and Ostara for clarity and new purpose

herb-cedar.bestTime: Evergreen; cut tips in winter (Dec–Feb), strongest at Yule

herb-juniper.bestTime: Berries ripen autumn (Oct–Nov); strongest at Samhain and Hogmanay for saining

herb-pine.bestTime: Needles and resin in winter (Dec–Feb), strongest at Yule; cones in autumn

herb-eucalyptus.bestTime: Evergreen, year-round; strongest in winter cold season (Nov–Feb)

herb-elder.bestTime: Flowers at Litha (June), berries at Mabon (Sept); ask permission before cutting

herb-hawthorn.bestTime: Beltane — blossoms in May (do not bring indoors); berries in autumn (Sept–Oct)

herb-rowan.bestTime: Berries at Mabon (Sept); wood cut at Imbolc or Beltane for protection charms

herb-oak.bestTime: Leaves at Litha (Oak King), acorns at Mabon (Sept–Oct); strongest at Midsummer

herb-willow.bestTime: Bark and withies in early spring (Feb–Apr); strongest at Beltane and under moonlight

herb-birch.bestTime: Earliest spring — sap and twigs at Imbolc to Ostara (Feb–Mar)

herb-mistletoe.bestTime: Cut at Midwinter / Yule (or sixth night of the moon after Yule); also Midsummer

herb-holly.bestTime: Midwinter — cut at Yule (Dec); Holly King rules Litha to Yule

herb-ivy.bestTime: Evergreen; gather in winter (Nov–Jan), strongest at Yule

herb-dandelion.bestTime: Leaves in spring (Mar–May), flowers at Beltane, roots dug in autumn (Sept–Oct); seed clocks at full moon

herb-nettle.bestTime: Young tops in spring (Mar–May); seeds late summer; strongest at Beltane

herb-burdock.bestTime: Dig first-year roots in autumn (Sept–Nov), strongest at Samhain

herb-comfrey.bestTime: Leaves late spring to summer (May–Aug); roots in autumn

herb-mullein.bestTime: Flower spikes at Midsummer (July–Aug); stalks for hag's tapers at Samhain

herb-red-clover.bestTime: Late spring to summer in bloom (May–Aug), strongest at Beltane

herb-echinacea.bestTime: Flowers in summer (July–Aug), roots in autumn of 3rd year (Sept–Oct)

herb-elecampane.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn of 2nd year (Sept–Oct), strongest at Samhain

herb-angelica.bestTime: Stems in spring, roots in autumn of 1st year; strongest around Michaelmas (Sept 29) and Imbolc

herb-lovage.bestTime: Leaves late spring to summer (May–July), strongest at Beltane

herb-fennel.bestTime: Seeds in late summer (Aug–Sept); traditionally hung at Midsummer

herb-dill.bestTime: Seeds in late summer (Aug); hung at Midsummer against witchcraft

herb-caraway.bestTime: Seeds in late summer of 2nd year (July–Aug), strongest at Lammas

herb-coriander.bestTime: Seeds late summer (Aug–Sept), strongest at Lammas

herb-cumin.bestTime: Seeds late summer, imported year-round; strongest at Lammas

herb-black-pepper.bestTime: Imported, year-round; strongest at Samhain for banishing

herb-cayenne.bestTime: Pods ripen late summer to autumn (Aug–Oct)

herb-mustard-seed.bestTime: Seeds in late summer (Aug); strongest at Lammas

herb-bayberry.bestTime: Berries in autumn (Sept–Nov); candles burned at Yule and New Year's Eve

herb-allspice.bestTime: Imported, year-round; strongest Yule to Imbolc for prosperity

herb-cardamom.bestTime: Imported, year-round; strongest at Beltane and Yule

herb-vanilla.bestTime: Imported, year-round; strongest at Beltane and Valentine's season

herb-orange-peel.bestTime: Winter citrus season (Dec–Feb), strongest at Yule and Litha (solar)

herb-lemon.bestTime: Winter citrus season (Dec–Mar); strongest at Imbolc for cleansing

herb-apple.bestTime: Blossoms at Beltane (May), fruit at Mabon to Samhain (Sept–Oct)

herb-pomegranate.bestTime: Ripens in autumn (Oct–Nov), strongest at Samhain (Persephone's descent)

herb-raspberry-leaf.bestTime: Leaves before fruiting, late spring to summer (May–July)

herb-blackberry.bestTime: Fruit at Lammas (Aug); avoid after Michaelmas (Sept 29) per folklore

herb-strawberry.bestTime: Early summer fruiting (June), strongest at Litha

herb-damiana.bestTime: Leaves in summer flowering season (imported, year-round); strongest at Beltane

herb-hops.bestTime: Strobiles in late summer (Aug–Sept), strongest at Mabon

herb-blue-lotus.bestTime: Summer blooming (imported dried, year-round); strongest at full moons and Litha

herb-violet.bestTime: Early spring flowers (Mar–Apr), strongest at Ostara

herb-parsley.bestTime: Leaves summer; seeds sown at Good Friday folklore; strongest at Samhain for the dead

herb-tansy.bestTime: Late summer in flower (July–Sept); strongest at Samhain

herb-licorice-root.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn of 3rd–4th year (Sept–Nov)

herb-marshmallow-root.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn (Oct–Nov), strongest at Samhain

herb-black-cohosh.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn after fruiting (Sept–Oct)

herb-goldenseal.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn (Sept–Oct), strongest at Mabon

herb-ginseng.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn of 5th+ year (Sept–Oct), strongest at Mabon

herb-high-john-the-conqueror.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn (Sept–Oct); dressed and worked year-round, strongest at Lammas

herb-cinquefoil.bestTime: Summer in flower (June–Aug), strongest at Litha

herb-wood-betony.bestTime: Summer in flower (July–Aug), strongest at Litha

herb-meadowsweet.bestTime: Midsummer in flower (June–Aug); a sacred Druid herb of Litha

herb-vetiver.bestTime: Roots dug after 18 months, imported year-round; strongest at Mabon

herb-mandrake.bestTime: Dig roots in autumn (Oct), traditionally at Samhain

herb-belladonna.bestTime: Late summer to autumn (Aug–Oct); handle only with gloves, strongest at Samhain

herb-foxglove.bestTime: Early summer in flower (June), strongest at Beltane to Litha (faery season); handle with gloves

herb-datura.bestTime: Late summer nights in bloom (Aug–Sept); handle with gloves, strongest at Samhain

herb-henbane.bestTime: Summer in flower (June–Aug), strongest at Samhain; handle with gloves

herb-wolfsbane.bestTime: Summer in flower (July–Aug), strongest at Samhain; handle only with gloves

herb-ladys-mantle.bestTime: Early summer (June); dew gathered on Beltane or Midsummer morning

herb-sweetgrass.bestTime: Midsummer (June–July), braided fresh; strongest at Litha

herb-hibiscus.bestTime: Late summer to autumn in bloom (imported dried, year-round); strongest at Beltane

herb-saffron.bestTime: Autumn — stigmas picked at dawn in October flowering

herb-borage.bestTime: Summer in flower (June–Aug), strongest at Litha
